# assignmentB2SusanZhang

`assignmentB2SusanZhang` contains a function called `cup_converter` that can be used to convert baking ingredient measurements in cups into grams and milliliters. It requires you to specify what type of baking ingredient (either a `"liquid"`, `"flour"`, `"sugar"`, or `"butter"`), and the amount in cups. Running this function with these inputs will output a tibble that displays equivalent volumes in grams and milliliters.

## Installation

You can install this package from GitHub by: 
``` r
`devtools::install_github("/UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2SusanZhang")`
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2SusanZhang)
library(tibble) #required for cup_converter function

#convert one cup of flour to mL and grams
cup_converter("flour", 1)
```
